title: Entry-Timing Confirmation via Maximum Adverse Excursion: An Empirical Test on a Systematic Index Futures Strategy
summary: Explicit user-selected 0.25% test complete: FC2B and S47 lose net dollars in all five design years. VB subset weakly improves but stays negative with 106 unknown paths. No advancement.
about: Resting price-offset limits on a proprietary Nifty trend strategy, using original whole-trade MAE to infer eligibility and unchanged original exits.
findings: Author Nifty results remain unverified. New conditional fixed-parent NQ design 2018-04-02 through 2022-12-30, one MNQ: FC2B $11990.50 to $1358.38; S47 $14126.42 to $6228.92; VB conditional -$1281.02 to -$191.34, paired t .66, 106 unknowns.
mechanism: Mechanical price improvement on retained fixed-exit trades; conviction/adverse-selection filtering is proposed but not isolated. Missed profitable exposure and deterioration can outweigh savings.
build_on: Requested bounded test completed; no profile passes. No control, 2023+, independent native or account stage earned. Preserve all prior source and timing history without a new offset rescue.
